content:
Asha Patel: Quick sync — we need to schedule a security + access recert meeting for the new telemetry pipeline and the S3/bucket access changes. Two options: Wed 3/9 10:00am PT or Thu 3/10 2:00pm PT. Who can make which? Please vote and add agenda items.

Maria Chen: Wed works for me. Can we add service-account inventory + who holds long-lived keys?

Dave Li: I prefer Thu 2pm (calendar is lighter). Also suggest we cover data retention TTLs for telemetry (we changed retention in the RFC).

Liza Gomez: Either is ok but prefer 45m block. Can we have pre-reads uploaded 24h in advance? Also cc @legal for compliance on telemetry retention. :eyes:

Samir Shah: I can join either but need infra + platform lead present for the S3 ACL change. Can @Dave confirm who from infra?

Asha Patel: Noted. Draft agenda below — please comment/edit. If no objections I'll send calendar invite for the option that gets most votes.

```
Proposed agenda (45m)
- 5m: quick context + goals (Asha)
- 15m: threat model walkthrough for telemetry pipeline (Maria)
- 10m: access recert / S3 ACL changes + service accounts (Dave / infra)
- 10m: retention & compliance impacts (Liza / legal)
- 5m: action items, owners, follow-ups
```

security-bot: Poll: https://who.example.com/p/abc123 — vote by EOD today. :calendar:

Dave Li: Infra attendee is Casey Wong (will confirm). I'll also upload the ACL diff to the thread tomorrow.

Maria Chen: I'll upload the threat-model draft (link will be in thread) and a short checklist for reviewers. Asha — can you add the RFC link here when you have a sec?

Asha Patel: RFC link: https://redwood/internal/rfcs/telemetry-pipeline-2026. Uploaded the service-account spreadsheet: https://files.redwood/sheets/telemetry-sa.

Liza Gomez: Thanks — I added a short legal note in the shared doc about retention windows. If legal wants to join, please ask.

Samir Shah: Ping @casey and @leo from infra in #eng-infra to ask them to attend. I'll follow up after poll closes.

Maria Chen: Quick ask for reviewers: look at threat-model section 2 (data flows) and section 4 (failure modes). If you can comment inline by Monday EOD that would be great.

Dave Li: I'll do ACL review tomorrow morning and leave inline comments.

Asha Patel: Sounds good — if Wed gets the majority we'll aim for 3/9 10:00am PT (45m). If Thu wins then 3/10 2:00pm PT. I'll schedule and add Zoom + agenda pack.

Liza Gomez: One more item — audit evidence owners. Can we add a 1-line owner for each checklist item in the doc?

Asha Patel: Yes — assigning evidence owners during the meeting is on the agenda.

security-bot: Reminder: poll closes in 6h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maria Chen: I'll review and leave comments by Monday. :+1:

Dave Li: Confirmed Casey will join if Thu; may be remote for Wed but can still attend.

Asha Patel: Thanks everyone — will finalize after poll and post calendar invite.
